title: Shared-host turns
current: Each Test Machine keeps one FIFO waiting line (qa_host_waits). A scoped QA plan execution whose host is leased or unhealthy, and a refused manual QA_HOST:<machine> acquire, both join it. Unhealthy means the newer of the host's verification and its last successful golden capture is a failed verification; reset and diagnosis receipts never decide it. The plan runner prints 'Queued for QA host <machine>, position N of M' with the park command, and the item and run QA-stage wakes teach: if your host is busy, let the plan runner queue you, then park; you'll be woken when it's your turn, with no free-text host hold. Every release of a healthy host, including yoke claims work release by claim id, reserves it for the oldest live waiter and wakes that session; the waiter's next acquire consumes the turn. An unhealthy host is never reserved: it stays free for the operator's verify or golden capture, whose successful release wakes the first waiter. Session end, execution settlement and releasing an unused reservation cancel the wait. Before it parks, a queued plan runs and records every remaining host-free automatic case (Command, Command (CI)) and names them in the park message; a failing one is recorded without leaving the line, and the cursor steps over recorded cases on resume. Machine cases, inherit chains and agent- or human-judged cases keep roster order. The claim_held refusal names the session's place in line, the holder's own release command, the steering-seat recovery and the park instruction.
desired: Live proof on a registered test host: a member plan started while the host is leased is queued and woken on release, then takes the turn; and a plan queued on an unhealthy host is woken by a successful golden capture, without a steerer notifying anyone by hand; and on a contended run a queued plan's host-free Command cases record before it parks and are not rerun on resume.
